content_sections.heading: CDAC Database Developer Consultant Selection Process 2026
content_sections.text: The selected database developer will play a key role in the design of schemas and objects maintaining the established standards, including re-modelling structures or queries for increased performance. Will actively participate with the application teams in creating complex queries for the application. Will continuously monitor the database performance and engage in tuning exercises. Will help various support groups like operations and data-centre teams to schedule and monitor database backups, build and test database recovery models, spin new database instances and setup HA and Replication models. Will report to the Senior Technical Program Manager (Applications).

content_sections.heading: How to Apply
content_sections.text: Applications must be submitted online on or before 03-10-2026. To apply directly, use the Apply Online link provided in the Important Links section. Alternatively, candidates may visit the official website of CDAC to complete the application. Fill out the application form carefully with correct personal, educational, and contact details. Upload required documents such as photograph, signature, and certificates in the prescribed format. Pay the application fee online, if applicable. Review all details carefully before submitting the form. Take a printout or save a copy of the submitted application for future reference.

faq.question: Q1. What is the last date to apply for the CDAC Database Developer Consultant position?
faq.answer: The last date to submit the online application form for the CDAC Database Developer Consultant recruitment is 03-10-2026.

faq.question: Q2. How many vacancies are available for the Database Developer Consultant post?
faq.answer: There are a total of 2 vacancies announced for the Database Developer Consultant position by CDAC.

faq.question: Q3. What is the minimum educational qualification required for this post?
faq.answer: Candidates must have a First Class B.E./B.Tech or MCA or ME/M.Tech in relevant engineering disciplines to be eligible.

faq.question: Q4. What is the maximum age limit for the Database Developer Consultant role?
faq.answer: The maximum age limit for candidates applying for the Database Developer Consultant post is 50 years.

faq.question: Q5. What is the application mode for this recruitment?
faq.answer: The application process for the CDAC Database Developer Consultant recruitment is strictly online.

faq.question: Q6. What is the required experience for the Database Developer Consultant position?
faq.answer: Candidates need to have 7-10 years of total industry experience, with 4-6 years specifically in the role of a Database Developer.

faq.question: Q7. Is there any application fee mentioned for this recruitment?
faq.answer: No application fee has been mentioned in the official notification for this recruitment drive.

faq.question: Q8. What is the salary structure for the Database Developer Consultant?
faq.answer: The salary for the Database Developer Consultant will be commensurate with their experience, qualifications, and skill sets.

faq.question: Q9. Where will the selected candidate be posted?
faq.answer: The job location is mentioned as Delhi, and the recruitment is open across India.

faq.question: Q10. Who will the selected Database Developer Consultant report to?
faq.answer: The selected Database Developer Consultant will report to the Senior Technical Program Manager (Applications).
